title: Amagami SS+ plus
synopsis:
The girls return, and this time the series examines what the future with each of his girlfriends would hold! If Junichi can handle a second go-round with Tsukasa, Rihoko, Ai, Kaoru, Sae, Haruka and even Risa is anyone's guess. To add to the fun, little sister Miya returns with her sneaky storyline as well!

(Source: Sentai Filmworks)

episodes.title: Tsukasa Ayatsuji, Part 1
episodes.synopsis: Tsukasa runs for Student Council and elects Junichi as her vice president. However, things hit a snag when someone else chooses Junichi as a vice presidential candidate.

episodes.title: Tsukasa Ayatsuji, Part 2
episodes.synopsis: Junichi almost falls prey to a vicious trick. Later, Tsukasa delivers an inspiring speech that might win the election!

episodes.title: Rihoko Sakurai, Part 1
episodes.synopsis: Junichi suffers from fatigue caused by a poor diet. To his surprise, Rihoko cooks for him.

episodes.title: Rihoko Sakurai, Part 2
episodes.synopsis: Makabe resolves to leave Rihoko alone. Junichi feels awkward around Rihoko now that he realizes she loves him.

episodes.title: Ai Nanasaki, Part 1
episodes.synopsis: Junichi and Ai reminisce about their year of dating during a trip to the beach.

episodes.title: Ai Nanasaki, Part 2
episodes.synopsis: During the Founder's Festival, Miya and Sae play the lead roles in Romeo and Juliet while Ai works at the Oden Stand for the Girl's Swim Team.

episodes.title: Kaoru Tanamachi, Part 1
episodes.synopsis: We catch a glimpse of part of the summer that Kaoru spent with Junichi and how the details of their friendship was called into question by onlookers.

episodes.title: Kaoru Tanamachi, Part 2
episodes.synopsis: Junichi and Kaoru miss the bus and are subsequently picked up by a truck whose driver drops them at a hot spring. They receive some relationship advice.

episodes.title: Sae Nakata, Part 1
episodes.synopsis: Junichi and Sae have been dating for almost a year, and Sae's self-confidence has improved greatly. As a result, her quality of life has improved.

episodes.title: Sae Nakata, Part 2
episodes.synopsis: Tsukasa helps Sae with her duties for the Founder's Festival; meanwhile Junichi is feeling blue about not spending a lot of time with Sae.

episodes.title: Haruka Morishima, Part 1
episodes.synopsis: Haruka catches Junichi by surprise when she brings up a dreaded subject: meeting the parents!

episodes.title: Haruka Morishima, Part 2
episodes.synopsis: Junichi receives a shock when Haruka announces she will soon be leaving for England.

episodes.title: Miya Tachibana
episodes.synopsis: Miya mistakenly brings bath salts to Junichi which are "Abstinence Salts."
